pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

head.desc: the head: a kind brown eye under a soft brow, a neat chestnut moustache, chestnut hair swept over the forehead; pivot at the neck (0, 20)

head_blink.desc: eye shut; pivot at the neck (0, 20)

head_talk.desc: mouth open; pivot at the neck (0, 20)

head_happy.desc: eye squeezed up in a smile (the embrace); pivot at the neck (0, 20)

crown.desc: the crown of chestnut leaves: five serrated leaves fanned up from a gold band, a chestnut at the front; pivot at its foot on the head

cape.desc: the chestnut-brown cape, behind everything, its cream lining turned at the front edge and rolled as a collar; pivot at the shoulders

coat.desc: the coat: chestnut-leaf green with a gold placket and hem, three chestnut buttons, a brown belt with a gold buckle; root card, pivot (0, 6)

arm_front.desc: the front arm: a green sleeve with a gold cuff and a bare hand; pivot at the shoulder

arm_back.desc: the back arm, a tone darker: a green sleeve with a gold cuff and a bare hand; pivot at the shoulder

boots.desc: two brown riding boots, the far one a tone darker, under the coat's hem; pivot on the ground between them
